name: smwmusic-mega-man-x6-hi-max-mega-man-x2-mix
title: Mega Man X6 - Hi-Max (Mega Man X2 Mix)
description:
A boss theme for High Max (Hi-Max) from Mega Man X6, redone with the instruments of Mega Man X2. Some part of composition was influnced by the YM2612 cover from nineko and Tweaker.

This port uses the optimized SMW sample set.
